assessments.reasoning: The revision 84592 Oracle manual's §1.7 explicitly situates its SQL language relative to ANSI/ISO SQL and identifies extension and missing-feature classes.

challenge.method: Checked §1.7's use of multiple SQL editions, its description of SQL modes and its separate extension section on physical page 80 against a reading that the relationship asserts completeness for one ISO edition.
challenge.results: The manual distinguishes several SQL editions and names conformance as a goal alongside product-specific extensions. Its explicit comparison supports the general dialect relation with the base SQL language.

limitations: The reviewed relationship is to SQL generally. ISO edition conformance and portability require separately scoped support.
